notes:
Mathematical content: the leaf continues a list of equivalent conditions concerning a local homomorphism: injectivity; a positive integral multiple of a lacet map on inertia; nontrivial inertia; nonextension of the associated group section; and nonregularity of the rational section. The rewritten paragraph expresses the boundary value as f-tilde(s) in I = X_s minus U_s and identifies the index i with that value. In this case it identifies N_s-prime, isomorphic to E_tildeK, with a subgroup of E_Xs of finite index mu in a normalizer N(L_i), then begins another statement about the scindage that continues beyond the leaf.

The complete leaf and each supplied full-resolution half were viewed once. Every main-text word, including C/H agreements, was checked against the ink. Twenty-two unique full-resolution crops were autocontrasted and enlarged with LANCZOS to 2200 pixels wide; decided places were not recropped. Existing crops were reused for the local index comparison.

Line count: 30 handwritten baselines, consisting of 22 main reading-stream baselines, seven interlinear correction baselines, and the folio. The two final raised additions occupy the same interlinear level and are counted as one baseline. The separate levels of the cancelled existence formula are preserved.

The heading has no colon. Cet begins with a capital C. The four hom occurrences lack abbreviation points, and conditions a) through e) have no terminal full stops. Existing points in ext., i.e., sect., rat., the boundary formula, and the following prose are retained. On a has a capital O.

Condition b) reads hom lacet: the final t is crossed. Both visible operators in the local formula are hollow circles; the inner one is not changed to a multiplication dot. The two local-map labels remain kappa|k because their straight stems do not distinguish the scripts securely.

In e), the single-rise cap over U is distinct from the adjacent tilde over f, so M1248 resolves to widehat U. No subscript K is present there.

The nested subscript under U in the insertion of d) and in the last main-baseline group has a low arch with a descending right leg. Eta is preferred, with K retained in a local doubt at each occurrence. Nearby outer K symbols have separate branches. The heavily retraced U in d) has no secure recoverable underlying letter; no deletion or replacement history is invented for that retracing.

The rewritten f paragraph has a cancelled f) label and Si, with Désignons par inserted above. Cancelled writing after the first f continues beyond désigne/désignons to further strokes compatible with aussi, ending in a dotted i. All obscured cancelled letters remain doubtful. The loc./cancelled les place has uncertain wording and uncertain deletion state.

The cancelled existence fragment has a lower baseline exists i ... tel que and a distinct upper i in I(k), relation, colon. Both levels are retained. The upper relation is read simeq|sim because a visible lower bar may coincide with the cancellation stroke. No copy of the lower i is silently dropped.

The underlining begins below the compressed ns|nous and continues through identifier le groupe de décomposition. Pouvons is clear; the pronoun remains doubtful, with the short form ns preferred.

The ext. de E_k(s) par pi insertion is attached after E_Xs and its comma, before qui est. Its curved leader is not a parenthesis. The written pi is retained and the note is read as describing E_Xs. H's explanatory note is editorial, and no other leaf or purported correction was consulted.

The three supplied mark IDs alone appear in marks. M1248 is a certainty resolution recorded there; its different H formula is separately collated. M1249 and M1250 remain undecided. Conventional calligraphic E/O encoding is not counted as a lexical difference. The leaf ends after de, without a supplied continuation or ellipsis.

No OCR, external research, inspection of another leaf, or TeX compilation was used. Mathematical checks are listed separately and are explicitly conditional where the isolated leaf does not supply all hypotheses.

check_events.outcome: Assume the rational section has the displayed extension to the separated ambient X over the local trait. Its inverse image of the open U is an open subset of that trait. An open subset containing the closed point contains the generic point and hence the whole trait. Therefore the X-section factors through U exactly when its closed value lies in U_s. If that value lies in X_s minus U_s, no U-extension with the same generic section exists, by separatedness/uniqueness. This verifies the boundary-value criterion under the stated ambient-extension assumptions; it does not prove all the preceding equivalences.

Conditional algebraic check: if T is the full procyclic Tate module (abstractly the product of Z_l over all primes) and the lacet map is injective, multiplication by a positive integer mu is injective, since every Z_l is torsion-free. Its cokernel is the product of Z_l/mu Z_l, whose order is the product l^{v_l(mu)} = mu. If a subgroup H of a normalizer N maps onto the same quotient and meets T in mu T, then N = T H and the coset index [N:H] equals [T:mu T] = mu. This confirms the displayed finite-index conclusion under those assumptions, without claiming the isolated leaf proves them or that a prime-restricted T would give the same index.
